case.body: floating hemisphere, flat face on the mean free surface

reference_provenance.citation: Hulme, A. (1982) The wave forces acting on a floating hemisphere undergoing forced periodic oscillations. J. Fluid Mech. 121:443-463.
reference_provenance.method: spherical wave-free multipole expansion (Hulme's semi-analytical solution)
reference_provenance.paper_digit_transcription: NOT AVAILABLE in this sandbox (publisher paywall). The reference is the re-derived series, not the printed table; self-convergence (48/96/144 terms, gate G4) plus a third-code independent judge (capytaine, gate G5) are the substitute evidence. See docs/bem_hulme_hemisphere_case.md section 1.

independent.role: third-code independent judge; never imported by tensorbem solvers

B33_dimless.method_exact: finest-value fallback (residual ratio d21/d32=-2.682: not monotone decreasing)
B33_dimless.method: finest-value fallback (residual ratio d21/d32=-2.682: not monotone decreasing)

benchmark.independent_method: finest-value fallback (residual ratio d21/d32=-2.682: not monotone decreasing)

G1_case_mesh_band_error_below_5pct.criterion: |rel err vs Hulme series| < 5% for every quantity and every ka, case mesh

G2_geometry_precondition.criterion: |nabla_mesh/nabla-1| < 2% and |A_wp/(pi a^2)-1| < 2% on the case mesh

G3_refinement_does_not_worsen.criterion: band-max error at 1024 panels <= band-max error at 256 panels

G4_reference_self_converged.criterion: reference 96->144 term drift at least 20x below the 5% gate

G5_independent_judge_below_5pct.criterion: |got - capytaine limit| / |limit| < 5% against EVERY admissible extrapolation (exact-order Richardson, geometric-p Richardson, raw finest resolution) on the case mesh, judged ka

1.000/B33_dimless.method: finest-value fallback (residual ratio d21/d32=-2.682: not monotone decreasing)

G6_independent_gap_shrinks_with_refineme.criterion: worst |got - capytaine limit| at 1024 panels < the same at 256 panels
